Aya Hisakawa (Japanese: 久川 綾 Hisakawa Aya) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Hisakawa was born on November 12, 1968 in , , and became an actress as an adult. She originally voiced Carol in the second movie and Luna Carson in Mewtwo Returns before returning to the franchise nearly two decades later in Pokémon Masters EX.
